name: mycodingagent-chat
description: Use the local myCodingAgent Python agent directly from the VS Code Copilot chat window via @myagent

chatParticipants.name: myagent
chatParticipants.description: Autonomous coding agent: creates, runs and fixes code in your workspace.

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Edit files only, no shell commands

myCodingAgent.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to run the agent.

myCodingAgent.agentFolder.description: Path to the myCodingAgent source folder containing agent.py and llm.py. Leave empty to auto-detect myCodingAgent/ from the opened workspace.

myCodingAgent.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds an agent task may run.

myCodingAgent.llmBaseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL (for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama). Leave empty to use OxAlpha.

myCodingAgent.llmModel.description: Model name required when an alternate LLM base URL is configured.

myCodingAgent.llmApiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the alternate provider API key. Not stored in VS Code settings; leave empty for local providers such as Ollama.
